question: Should official macOS releases require a configured NOTARYTOOL_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE and fail before packaging when the profile is unavailable?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades release availability for stronger notarization guarantees, and only release owners can approve that operational contract.

options.title: Require notarization for official releases
options.body: Adopt the profile requirement and update the protected release environment/runbook before the next macOS release.

options.title: Keep signing-only releases temporarily
options.body: Preserve the existing official release path until the release environment can reliably provide the managed profile.

recommendation.title: Require notarization for official releases
recommendation.body: Adopt the profile requirement and update the protected release environment/runbook before the next macOS release.
